body.target: Current S3 execution observation and documentation delta after S3-corr
body.provenance: Codex self-review of user-supplied execution record and current source; not an independent test execution

assessment.fresh_current_subject_observation: The 2026-09-29 S3 execution journal reports 17/17 product-flow and 2/2 package tests passed. Its flow/package SHA-256 bindings match the current files. Reviewed test cases at product-flow lines 232,286,433,869,1111 and package line 222 cross the Store, validated complete, real Rust, restart, authenticated Gateway, IPC coexistence and packaged persistence boundaries.
assessment.four_historical_reports: C2-store-final, C2-publish, C4-flow-final and C4-unattended old Task Store reports remain stale at their former subject revisions. The new S3 execution observation supplies current-file evidence for their scenarios, but does not rewrite or make those old reports fresh.
assessment.android: The JDK21 Gradle invocation completed BUILD SUCCESSFUL with :app:testDebugUnitTest UP-TO-DATE. No JVM test cases were re-executed in this invocation; the CR and contract disclose this correctly.
assessment.documentation: Current CR and product contract accurately summarize the command outcomes and explicitly limit smoke to local synthetic transport, with no external host deployment or physical-device validation. CR remains draft with commit_ref TBD, matching no commit.
assessment.metadata_gap: The execution journal source_revision hashes for CR and product contract refer to their pre-final-edit bytes. Those two documents were edited after the journal record; this review independently read their current bytes and binds their current hashes above. The mismatch does not change the test-file binding, but the execution record alone does not identify the final document revisions.
assessment.assurance_limit: The journal is caller-reported and includes command summaries rather than raw stdout attachments. This review assesses consistency and test boundary from current files; it does not independently re-execute the business commands or upgrade the caller report to independently observed PASS.
assessment.format: Scoped git diff --check was run read-only in this review and returned exit 0 with only line-ending warnings.

body.remaining: No code repair identified in reviewed scope. Keep historical stale reports and Android cached status explicit; review does not advance or close S3.
